title: Multiplication inverse of the specified finite point comparison
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, prime l different from char(D.k), finite E/Q_l, and n >= 0. For every cochain complex K of module sheaves over the constant A_(E,n+1) ring on Spec D.k, the specified finite tensor-unit comparison for any automorphism g of the point on K is the inverse of a complex isomorphism e. For every degree i, site object U, coefficient section b and inverse-image section x, e sends b times the specified tensor-unit comparison of x to c inverse(b) times x, where c is the coefficient structure map. Use the coordinate definitions of [def-pur-point-normalization-coordinates] and comparisons of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. No freeness or constructibility is assumed.

source.place: Natural Weil isomorphism; point normalization plan, steps 1--6; Deligne Weil II (1.1.7), pp. 150--151

proof.text: Specialize point_automorphism_finite_transport_inverse to an arbitrary point automorphism and an arbitrary complex. Its delta and two inverse equations form the desired isomorphism e. The unique sectionwise specification of inverseImageFiniteComparisonComplex rewrites the tensor-unit input to the existing multiplication coordinate equation.
